title: Ask puts a recording from History on the timeline and cuts where it is asked
goal: Asked to put the newest recording after the open one, or to cut a clip at a moment and dissolve across it, Ask on a video changes nothing today, while the agent skill does both. Ask should do both, judged by the video cases of its test set.
notes: Found by the-ask-test-set-scores-video-requests-too. Reproduce: Scripts/ask-eval.sh run --engine ask --cases video-latest-recording-after-this-one,video-dissolve-where-the-copy-starts --tag repro. Run 20261021-153141-ask: history case steps [run_command add_video_track], score 7.5; dissolve case steps [run_command split_at_playhead, set_transition dissolve], skipped: "Split at Playhead cannot run now: it needs a clip under the playhead" / "This video has no cuts", says "None of it could run. Nothing was changed." (8.6). Skill run 20261021-154541-skill scores 80.8 and 85 on the same two cases. AskTools.doing (Sources/PhotonzCore/AskPlanning.swift) has cut but not add_clip or list_history; the server has both (AgentVideo.swift, AgentTools.swift).
acceptance: The video-latest-recording-after-this-one eval case scores 70 or more for Ask (baseline 7.5 on 2026-10-21: Ask has no tool that adds a clip)
The video-dissolve-where-the-copy-starts eval case scores 70 or more for Ask (baseline 8.6: the model picked the Split at Playhead menu command, which could not run, instead of its cut tool)
The held-out total does not drop (baseline 18.2, video 12.5, run 20261021-154921-ask-held-out), reported with the climb total from Scripts/ask-eval.sh report
Nothing about any case is coded: a general fix to the tools or prompt

log.note: 2026-10-22 digest: tried the repro command in the notes; it did not test anything, because the local model runner was not running (Ask said it needs the runner, steps []), and the eval scored it anyway (filed the-ask-scoring-run-refuses-to-score-when-the-mo; the bogus run was removed). The gap itself is confirmed by reading: AskTools.doing in Sources/PhotonzCore/AskPlanning.swift has no add_clip, though AgentVideo.swift defines one for the external agent.
